name: Secure login and roles
use_case: Each person signs in and sees only what their role allows (astronaut, flight surgeon, mission control, admin).
how_we_build_it: BE1: JWT access + refresh tokens, role claim, FastAPI dependency require(role) inside every handler; FE login page.
done_when: Wrong role gets 403; expired token forces re-login; one test per route.

name: Crew profile and baseline
use_case: Stores synthetic age, sex, height, weight, history and baseline vitals so alerts are personal, not generic.
how_we_build_it: DB: crew_profile table + Alembic migration; BE1: CRUD API; FE: validated form (zod).
done_when: Profile saved; baseline fields filled after 3 simulated days.

name: Mission configurator
use_case: Pick ISS, Moon or Mars mode; this sets comms delay, radiation rates, supply limits and crew size for the whole app.
how_we_build_it: BE2: mission_config JSON schema stored in DB, read by every service through one config module; FE: mode selector.
done_when: Switching mode changes delay, thresholds and radiation live without restart.

name: Synthetic crew generator
use_case: Creates N fake astronauts with realistic, varied baselines for demos, ML training and load tests.
how_we_build_it: DB: seeded numpy generator using published physiological ranges; writes crew_profile rows; records seed.
done_when: 100 crews generated reproducibly; ranges pass sanity checks.

name: Mission timeline and phases
use_case: Defines mission days and phases (launch, transit, EVA, landing) because health risk changes by phase.
how_we_build_it: DB: mission_phase table; BE2: API; FE: horizontal timeline bar on mission overview.
done_when: Phase change alters risk context shown on dashboards.

name: Consent and data-use notice
use_case: Shows what is monitored and who can see it; the astronaut acknowledges before data flows.
how_we_build_it: FE: modal with versioned text; DB: consent_log (user, version, time).
done_when: No data screens until consent logged; version bump re-prompts.

name: Onboarding wizard
use_case: Guides first-time setup: profile, device pairing, first baseline check.
how_we_build_it: FE: stepper reusing form components; BE1: onboarding_status endpoint.
done_when: New user completes wizard in under 3 minutes; resume works.

name: Device pairing (simulated + real adapter)
use_case: Connects the wearable simulator, or a real sensor if hardware is confirmed, so data starts flowing.
how_we_build_it: BE2: device registry + adapter interface (SimulatorAdapter, SerialBLEAdapter stub); pairing code flow.
done_when: Simulator pairs; adapter interface documented so hardware can plug in later.
honest_limit: Real adapter is covered by X05 for the demo; keep the adapter interface.

name: Medical kit inventory
use_case: Records onboard medicines and supplies with quantity and expiry so the system can warn before shortages.
how_we_build_it: DB: inventory table; BE2: CRUD + expiry query; FE: table with low-stock chips.
done_when: Low and expired items highlighted; CSV import works.

name: Demo seed data and scenario loader
use_case: One command loads crew, 30 days of history and the scripted scenarios used in the demo.
how_we_build_it: DB: idempotent seed scripts (make seed); fixtures versioned in repo.
done_when: Fresh database to demo-ready in under 2 minutes; running twice changes nothing.

name: Vitals simulator engine
use_case: Streams heart rate, SpO2, blood pressure, temperature, respiration and HRV as if from wearables so every feature has live data.
how_we_build_it: ML1: seeded Python generator with circadian rhythm, noise, mission-phase and scenario effects; publishes JSON over WebSocket/Redis at 1 Hz (configurable, time-accelerated for demos).
done_when: Same seed gives same stream; 6 crew at 1 Hz for 1 hour with no drift or crash.

name: Real dataset replay
use_case: Replays public datasets (NASA OSDR, PhysioNet, wearable-stress sets) as live streams so results rest on real physiology, not only simulation.
how_we_build_it: ML1: one loader per dataset into a common schema; time-scaled replay; licence + source stored per file (see F125).
done_when: 3 datasets replay through the same ingest path; provenance tag visible in UI.

name: Telemetry ingestion API
use_case: Accepts readings from devices and simulators safely and fast.
how_we_build_it: BE1: POST + WebSocket endpoints, Pydantic validation, batching, idempotency key, writes via async DB pool.
done_when: 1,000 readings/s accepted; bad payloads rejected with error code; no duplicates on retry.

name: Time-series storage
use_case: Stores millions of readings cheaply and answers 'last 24 hours' instantly.
how_we_build_it: DB: PostgreSQL + TimescaleDB hypertable, compression, continuous aggregates (1 min, 1 h), retention policy.
done_when: 24 h query for 1 crew under 100 ms with 10 M rows.

name: Live vitals dashboard (astronaut)
use_case: Shows current vitals as colored tiles against the personal baseline.
how_we_build_it: FE: React + Recharts, WebSocket hook with reconnect, tile states (normal/watch/alert), skeletons.
done_when: Updates within 1 s of ingest; works at 390 px and 1440 px.

name: Vital trend charts
use_case: 24 h / 7 d / mission-long trends with a baseline band so slow drift is visible.
how_we_build_it: FE: chart component with range switch; BE1: aggregate endpoint from continuous aggregates.
done_when: Range switch under 300 ms; baseline band drawn.
honest_limit: Tier 1 but not on the 48 h demo spine; first thing to add after Wave 1.

name: Threshold alert engine (rules)
use_case: Instant, explainable alerts (for example SpO2 below limit) that work even if ML is off.
how_we_build_it: BE1: rules table (metric, op, value, severity, duration), evaluator on stream, dedupe + cooldown.
done_when: Rule fires within 2 s; same condition not re-alerted inside cooldown.

name: Personal baseline calculator
use_case: Learns each person's normal range (by time of day) so alerts reflect them, not a population average.
how_we_build_it: DB: rolling median + MAD per metric per hour-of-day; recalculated nightly; stored with version.
done_when: Baseline for 6 crew computed; unit test with known synthetic data.
honest_limit: Keep as the simple comparison baseline; X02 (Bayesian N-of-1) is the main model.

name: Signal quality and missing-data handling
use_case: Flags sensor dropouts and artifacts so false alarms fall.
how_we_build_it: BE1: plausibility ranges, flatline and spike detection, short-gap interpolation, quality flag on every reading.
done_when: Injected dropouts flagged 100%; no alert fires from a flagged reading.

name: Cabin environment telemetry
use_case: CO2, O2, pressure, temperature, humidity and noise sit beside vitals because they cause symptoms.
how_we_build_it: BE1: environment simulator (leaks, CO2 build-up scenarios) + ingestion; FE panel reuses tiles.
done_when: CO2 scenario visibly raises alerts; panel shows 5 gauges.
honest_limit: Promoted to Tier 1: X09 (cabin-to-body warning) cannot work without cabin telemetry.

name: Radiation dose tracker
use_case: Cumulative dose against a career-limit gauge, by mission mode.
how_we_build_it: BE2: daily dose model per mode + SPE spikes; DB: cumulative table; FE: gauge.
done_when: Dose accumulates per crew per mode; limit gauge turns amber/red.

name: Solar particle event simulator and warning
use_case: Sudden radiation spike triggers a shelter warning for the crew.
how_we_build_it: BE2: event scheduler, alert with shelter checklist, countdown; hooks into scenario engine.
done_when: Trigger from demo panel warns all crew in under 3 s.

name: Sleep tracking
use_case: Estimates sleep duration and quality from motion and heart rate and flags sleep debt.
how_we_build_it: ML1: rule/HMM-style classifier on simulated actigraphy + HR; DB: sleep_session table.
done_when: Nightly sleep summary produced; debt computed over 7 days.

name: Activity and exercise tracker
use_case: Logs treadmill and resistive workouts and compares them with the prescription.
how_we_build_it: BE1: workout API + adherence calc; FE: simple log form + weekly ring.
done_when: Adherence percent shown; missed-workout flag for surgeon.

name: Bone and muscle loss estimator
use_case: Estimates monthly bone and muscle change from mission time and exercise adherence (microgravity effect).
how_we_build_it: ML2: parametric model using published loss-rate ranges (assumptions documented) with exercise modifier and uncertainty band.
done_when: Model gives range, not one number; assumptions page cites sources.

name: Nutrition and hydration logger
use_case: Logs meals and fluids and totals calories, protein, sodium and fluids against targets.
how_we_build_it: DB: food_catalog + intake tables; BE2: totals endpoint; FE: quick-add list.
done_when: Daily totals correct against hand-calculated example.

name: Daily health check-in form
use_case: A 60-second form for symptoms, pain, mood and energy.
how_we_build_it: FE: dynamic form from schema; BE1: endpoint; DB: check_in table.
done_when: Completed in under 60 s; saved offline if link down (F039).

name: Structured symptom checker
use_case: Pick from a space-relevant symptom list (motion sickness, headache, congestion, back pain, blurred vision) with severity.
how_we_build_it: ML2: symptom ontology JSON (codes, synonyms, red flags); FE: multi-select with severity slider.
done_when: 30+ symptoms coded; red-flag symptoms trigger escalation rule.

name: Voice symptom logging
use_case: Hands-free logging when wearing gloves or working.
how_we_build_it: ML2: local Whisper speech-to-text, then LLM extracts symptoms; FE: mic button.
done_when: Spoken sentence becomes structured entry with user confirm step.

name: Mood and stress scales
use_case: Very short validated scales (PHQ-2, GAD-2 style) and mood trend.
how_we_build_it: FE: scale components; BE1: scoring; DB: scale_result.
done_when: Scores match published scoring tables; trend chart.

name: Cognitive performance test
use_case: 3-minute reaction-time and memory test detects fatigue or CO2 effects.
how_we_build_it: FE: JS reaction timer + n-back; BE1: store scores; ML1 uses as feature.
done_when: Test runs at 60 fps; result compared to personal baseline.

name: Pain and injury body map
use_case: Tap a body diagram to log where it hurts and how much.
how_we_build_it: FE: SVG body map with regions; DB: pain_log.
done_when: Front/back map; region ids stored; history overlay.

name: Skin and wound photo log
use_case: Attach photos for rashes or wounds and track healing.
how_we_build_it: DB: file storage metadata + upload API; FE: camera/file input.
done_when: Photo stored with timestamp, size-limited, viewable by surgeon.

name: Medication log
use_case: Records medicines taken and warns about double doses or interactions.
how_we_build_it: DB: medication table + interaction rule lookup (small curated list); FE: quick log.
done_when: Double dose and 3 sample interactions detected.

name: Check-in reminders and streaks
use_case: Gentle nudges and missed check-in alerts to the surgeon.
how_we_build_it: BE1: APScheduler jobs; FE: toast and badge.
done_when: Missed check-in flagged after configurable window.

name: Free-text note structuring
use_case: Write or dictate a note; AI extracts symptoms, medicines and severity.
how_we_build_it: ML2: LLM JSON extraction with schema validation + retry; confidence shown.
done_when: 95 percent of 50 test notes parse to valid JSON.

name: Crew wellbeing and isolation pulse
use_case: Weekly team-connection and conflict pulse, anonymous to crew, aggregated for surgeons.
how_we_build_it: BE1: survey API with aggregation threshold (no results under 3 responses); FE form.
done_when: Aggregates hidden below threshold.

name: Private mode and sharing controls
use_case: Astronaut chooses which mental-health fields the surgeon sees; emergency override exists.
how_we_build_it: BE1: field-level ACL; FE: toggles; override logged in audit (F124).
done_when: Hidden field never in API response unless override.

name: Offline-first check-in queue
use_case: Check-ins save on the device if the link is down and sync later.
how_we_build_it: FE: IndexedDB queue + service worker; BE1: idempotent endpoint.
done_when: Airplane-mode test: 5 entries sync once, no duplicates.

name: Accessibility mode for suited use
use_case: Large buttons, high contrast and voice-first flow for gloves and microgravity.
how_we_build_it: FE: theme with 48 px targets, keyboard paths, reduced motion.
done_when: axe has 0 serious issues; all core flows keyboard-only.

name: Anomaly detection (unsupervised)
stage: AI risk detection and decision support
use_case: Flags unusual patterns versus personal baseline even when no rule exists.
how_we_build_it: ML1: Isolation Forest + robust z-score ensemble per metric; evaluate on injected anomalies; compare with rules only.
done_when: Beats rules-only recall on injected set at equal false-alarm rate.
honest_limit: Keep as a comparison baseline against X02.

name: Multivariate time-series anomaly (deep)
stage: AI risk detection and decision support
use_case: Catches combined small changes (HR up, HRV down, sleep short) that single thresholds miss.
how_we_build_it: ML1: PyTorch LSTM autoencoder on sliding windows; reconstruction-error threshold; ablation vs F041.
done_when: Reported AUROC/PR on held-out scenarios; training under 15 min on laptop.

name: Health risk score (0-100)
stage: AI risk detection and decision support
use_case: One readiness number combining vitals, sleep, stress and radiation.
how_we_build_it: ML1: LightGBM on simulator-labelled windows + monotone constraints; SHAP for explanation; calibrated.
done_when: Score ordered correctly on 20 scripted cases; calibration plot saved.
honest_limit: Keep as a comparison baseline against X02.

name: Early-warning forecaster (24-72 h)
stage: AI risk detection and decision support
use_case: Predicts where vitals and risk are heading before a limit is crossed.
how_we_build_it: ML1: Prophet or small LSTM/N-BEATS; rolling backtest; MAE vs naive baseline.
done_when: Beats naive forecast on backtest; horizon selectable.
honest_limit: X02 already gives a short forecast; add this if time allows.

name: Condition classifier
stage: AI risk detection and decision support
use_case: Suggests probable conditions (dehydration, infection, CO2 exposure, fatigue, anxiety, decompression-type symptoms) with probabilities.
how_we_build_it: ML2: classifier on scripted-scenario data + rule priors; top-3 output; abstain option.
done_when: Macro-F1 reported; confusion matrix; abstains when unsure.

name: Space-specific syndromes module
stage: AI risk detection and decision support
use_case: Tracks space-unique risks: spaceflight-associated neuro-ocular syndrome, space motion sickness, clots, kidney stones, cardio deconditioning.
how_we_build_it: ML2: knowledge base + rule scorer using risk factors, citing NASA HRP evidence documents.
done_when: Each syndrome has indicators, sources and a test case.

name: Explainable AI panel data
stage: AI risk detection and decision support
use_case: 'Why did the AI flag this?' in plain words with top contributing factors.
how_we_build_it: ML1: SHAP values to templated sentences; API returns factors + direction + size.
done_when: Explanation present on 100% of ML alerts; reviewed for clarity.

name: Confidence and uncertainty
stage: AI risk detection and decision support
use_case: Every prediction shows confidence and an 'AI unsure' state.
how_we_build_it: ML1: isotonic calibration + ensemble variance / conformal intervals.
done_when: Reliability diagram committed; unsure state shown below threshold.
honest_limit: Build together with X04 (conformal abstention).

name: Alert triage and fusion
stage: AI risk detection and decision support
use_case: Merges rule, anomaly and risk alerts into one prioritized list without duplicates.
how_we_build_it: BE1: fusion service with severity matrix, suppression windows, source tags.
done_when: Duplicate storm of 50 raw alerts becomes under 5 grouped alerts.

name: False-alarm feedback loop
stage: AI risk detection and decision support
use_case: Surgeon marks alerts true or false and thresholds improve.
how_we_build_it: ML1: feedback table, per-person threshold adaptation, optional nightly retrain.
done_when: False-alarm rate drops on replay after feedback.

name: Circadian and sleep-debt model
stage: AI risk detection and decision support
use_case: Models fatigue from schedule (Mars sol is about 24 h 39 min, shift work).
how_we_build_it: ML2: simplified two-process model with mission-mode parameter.
done_when: Fatigue curve responds to schedule shift test.

name: Stress and fatigue from HRV
stage: AI risk detection and decision support
use_case: Detects stress or fatigue from heart-rate variability features.
how_we_build_it: ML2: RMSSD/LF-HF features + classifier trained on public stress dataset; validated on simulator.
done_when: Reported accuracy on public set; used as feature in F043.

name: Radiation health-risk model
stage: AI risk detection and decision support
use_case: Converts dose to relative risk bands (acute symptoms, cumulative risk) with uncertainty.
how_we_build_it: ML2: lookup/linear model from public risk tables; clearly marked illustrative.
done_when: Bands change correctly when dose crosses limits.

name: Digital twin per astronaut
stage: AI risk detection and decision support
use_case: Simulates how this astronaut responds to scenarios ('no exercise for 2 weeks').
how_we_build_it: ML1: state-space model (bone, muscle, fluid shift, cardiovascular) with what-if API.
done_when: 3 what-if scenarios give plausible direction and range.

name: Offline medical assistant (RAG)
stage: AI risk detection and decision support
use_case: Ask medical questions and get answers citing the onboard knowledge base.
how_we_build_it: ML2: bge-small embeddings + FAISS/Chroma, retrieval + reranking, LLM answer with citations; chat UI built by ML2 on FE components.
done_when: Answers cite sources; 'I do not know' when nothing relevant.

name: Medical knowledge base builder
stage: AI risk detection and decision support
use_case: Ingests public medical and NASA human-research documents into searchable chunks.
how_we_build_it: ML2: loaders, cleaning, chunking, metadata, licence log, version tag.
done_when: 200+ chunks indexed; every chunk has source and licence.

name: LLM dual mode (cloud + local)
stage: AI risk detection and decision support
use_case: Uses a cloud LLM API when the link is up and a local open model offline.
how_we_build_it: ML2: router with health check, same prompt template, local model via Ollama/llama.cpp, mode logged.
done_when: Pull network cable: assistant keeps answering locally.

name: Guardrails and medical safety layer
stage: AI risk detection and decision support
use_case: Stops dangerous advice, adds disclaimers and escalates emergencies.
how_we_build_it: ML2: rule layer + LLM judge + red-team set of 50 prompts; emergency keywords escalate.
done_when: Red-team set passes 100% on critical cases.

name: Hallucination and citation checker
stage: AI risk detection and decision support
use_case: Checks each claim against retrieved text and flags unsupported ones.
how_we_build_it: ML2: overlap/NLI scoring, fallback to refusal.
done_when: Unsupported claims flagged on test set; precision reported.
honest_limit: Promoted to Tier 1: this is the citation check that makes X06 verifiable.

name: Autonomous triage protocol engine
stage: AI risk detection and decision support
use_case: When ground delay is long, guides step-by-step triage and queues a report for the surgeon.
how_we_build_it: BE2: JSON decision-tree engine + executor; ML2 supplies explanations; logs every step.
done_when: Mars-mode demo completes a triage with no ground contact.

name: Model monitoring and drift data
stage: AI risk detection and decision support
use_case: Tracks prediction drift and performance and alerts when a model degrades.
how_we_build_it: ML1: PSI/KS on features, rolling metrics, alert hook.
done_when: Injected drift detected within 1 day of simulated time.
honest_limit: X08 (self-watchdog) covers the demo need; this is the fuller version.

name: Model evaluation harness and reports
stage: AI risk detection and decision support
use_case: One command produces ROC/PR, MAE, confusion matrices and ablations for the report.
how_we_build_it: ML1: make eval; fixed seeds; outputs JSON + PNG + Markdown.
done_when: Two runs give identical numbers; report auto-built.

name: Emergency declaration button
use_case: One tap or spoken command declares a medical emergency and starts the protocol.
how_we_build_it: BE1: emergency event + broadcast; FE: big button with confirm.
done_when: Alert reaches all roles in under 3 s.

name: Emergency protocol library
use_case: Step-by-step guides for CPR, choking, burns, toxic atmosphere, fracture, allergic reaction, eye injury, dental pain.
how_we_build_it: DB: protocol content as versioned JSON; sourced from public first-aid guidance.
done_when: 10 protocols reviewed and cited.
honest_limit: Thin slice: only 3 protocols (CPR, toxic atmosphere, burns) for the 48 h cut.

name: Guided protocol runner
use_case: Interactive checklist with timers, branching questions and automatic logging.
how_we_build_it: FE: stepper UI; BE2 engine (F060); timers survive reload.
done_when: Run full CPR protocol end to end with log.

name: Crew medical officer mode
use_case: Designates a crew member as medical officer with extended access and checklists.
how_we_build_it: BE1: role + audit; FE: badge.
done_when: Role granted and revoked with audit entry.

name: Triage priority board
use_case: If several people are affected, ranks by severity.
how_we_build_it: BE2: START-like scoring adapted to crew; small board UI.
done_when: Order matches expected on 5 test cases.

name: Telemedicine session
use_case: Live text/voice/video consult between astronaut and surgeon with injected delay.
how_we_build_it: BE2: WebRTC (LiveKit or simple-peer) + delay emulator.
done_when: Call works locally with 5 s artificial delay.

name: Store-and-forward consult
use_case: Asynchronous messages and attachments delivered after the link delay.
how_we_build_it: BE2: durable queue with delay emulator from mission mode.
done_when: Message arrives after configured delay; survives restart.

name: Communication delay emulator
use_case: Injects realistic latency and blackout windows so the demo shows the real problem.
how_we_build_it: BE2: middleware on message bus using mission_config delay + blackout schedule.
done_when: Mars mode shows minutes of delay; ISS mode near zero.

name: Remote guidance cards
use_case: Surgeon sends a structured instruction card (steps + images) to the astronaut.
how_we_build_it: BE2: card API; BE2 also builds the composer and viewer UI.
done_when: Card sent, delivered after delay, acknowledged.

name: Vision self-test (SANS)
use_case: Simple acuity and Amsler grid test tracked over time for vision changes.
how_we_build_it: FE: canvas-based tests; DB: results table.
done_when: Results trend chart; flag on drop from baseline.

name: Medical event log
use_case: Tamper-evident timestamped record of emergency actions for debrief.
how_we_build_it: DB: append-only table with hash chain.
done_when: Altering any row breaks verification.

name: Auto incident report
use_case: Generates a structured SBAR-style report after an event.
how_we_build_it: ML2: LLM template from event log; PDF export via BE2.
done_when: Report generated within 10 s and matches log.

name: Supply decrement and low-stock alert
use_case: Using a medicine updates inventory and warns on low stock or expiry.
how_we_build_it: BE2: triggers on medication log + inventory.
done_when: Stock falls on use; alert at threshold.

name: Consumables forecast
use_case: Predicts when medicines run out based on usage and mission length.
how_we_build_it: BE2: exponential smoothing forecast; chart.
done_when: Forecast within 20% on simulated usage.

name: Abort and evacuation decision support
use_case: Shows options by mission mode (hours / days / not possible) with risk summary.
how_we_build_it: BE2: rules table + ML2 narrative.
done_when: Output differs correctly by mode.

name: Emergency drill mode
use_case: Run scripted emergencies with scoring for training and demo.
how_we_build_it: BE1: scoring over event log; reuses scenario engine.
done_when: Drill run scored on time and steps.

name: Personalized exercise prescription
use_case: Daily aerobic and resistive plan adapting to bone/muscle model, recovery and equipment.
how_we_build_it: ML1: rule + optimizer generating plans; BE2 API.
done_when: Plan changes when adherence or model output changes.

name: Exercise form and rep counting
use_case: Camera counts reps and checks form.
how_we_build_it: ML2: MediaPipe pose; FE widget.
done_when: Counts squats within 10% on test clips.

name: Nutrition planner
use_case: Builds menus within food-system limits for calories, protein and vitamin D.
how_we_build_it: BE2: constraint solver over food_catalog.
done_when: Menu meets targets for 3 test profiles.

name: Hydration and fluid-shift guidance
use_case: Reminders and advice for microgravity fluid shift.
how_we_build_it: BE2: rules from mission phase + intake logs.
done_when: Reminder logic tested on 3 cases.

name: Sleep optimization coach
use_case: Bedtime and light schedule suggestions from sleep model.
how_we_build_it: ML2: rule engine over F023/F051 outputs.
done_when: Suggestion changes with sleep debt.

name: Mental health companion
use_case: Private supportive chat with crisis detection and escalation to the surgeon.
how_we_build_it: ML2: LLM with guardrails (F058), risk phrase classifier, escalation hook.
done_when: Crisis test phrases always escalate.

name: Stress relief toolkit
use_case: Breathing guide and calm audio using HRV biofeedback.
how_we_build_it: FE: animated breathing pacer; reads live HRV.
done_when: Pacer runs; HRV change displayed.

name: Team dynamics monitor
use_case: Aggregated, anonymized sentiment highlights team stress.
how_we_build_it: ML2: sentiment model on opt-in text; aggregate only.
done_when: No individual text visible to MC.

name: Isolation and confinement tracker
use_case: Shows mission day, delay stress factors and known low-morale periods.
how_we_build_it: BE2: timeline-based rules.
done_when: Milestone alerts fire on schedule.

name: Weekly health goals and summary
use_case: Weekly digest of progress and goals.
how_we_build_it: DB: scheduled job + templated summary.
done_when: Summary generated for each crew weekly.

name: Motion sickness adaptation tracker
use_case: Predicts adaptation timeline during the first days.
how_we_build_it: ML2: simple regression over symptom logs.
done_when: Prediction range shown.

name: EVA readiness check
use_case: Pre-spacewalk checklist covering vitals, sleep, hydration and prebreathe time.
how_we_build_it: BE2: rules engine + go/no-go output.
done_when: Go/no-go changes with inputs.

name: EVA live monitoring view
use_case: Live suit vitals and O2/CO2 consumption during a spacewalk.
how_we_build_it: BE2: EVA scenario stream; BE2 builds view from shared tiles.
done_when: Live view updates during scripted EVA.

name: Decompression-risk estimator
use_case: Illustrative estimate of decompression-related risk from pressure profile.
how_we_build_it: ML1: published-ratio model clearly marked illustrative.
done_when: Risk rises with faster pressure drop.

name: Countermeasure adherence analytics
use_case: Compliance rates and their effect on bone/muscle trends.
how_we_build_it: DB: analytic views; FE chart.
done_when: Adherence vs trend chart renders.

name: Micro-lessons and quizzes
use_case: Two-minute refreshers on first aid and procedures.
how_we_build_it: DB: lesson content + quiz endpoints.
done_when: 10 lessons with quiz scoring.

name: Crew roster overview
use_case: One screen with every crew member as a status chip and risk score.
how_we_build_it: FE: card grid with live status, sorted by risk.
done_when: Status updates live; sort and filter work.

name: Patient detail view
use_case: Drill-down: vitals, trends, check-ins, meds, alerts timeline.
how_we_build_it: FE: tabbed page using shared charts.
done_when: All tabs load under 1 s.

name: Alert inbox and acknowledgment
use_case: Prioritized alerts with acknowledge, assign, snooze and resolve with notes.
how_we_build_it: BE1: alert state machine; BE1 builds inbox UI on shared table.
done_when: Ack changes state for all viewers live.

name: AI explanation and recommendation panel
use_case: Shows AI rationale, confidence, suggested actions and evidence.
how_we_build_it: ML1: panel built on F047/F048 endpoints.
done_when: Panel shown on every ML alert.

name: Clinical notes editor (SOAP)
use_case: Write notes with an AI-drafted summary the surgeon edits.
how_we_build_it: ML2: summary endpoint + editor component.
done_when: Draft generated; saved version history.

name: Orders and instructions
use_case: Send medication or exercise instructions with electronic acknowledgment.
how_we_build_it: BE1: orders API; astronaut ack flow.
done_when: Order delivered and acked.

name: Daily health brief
use_case: LLM-written daily brief per crew: what changed, what to watch.

name: Wait-or-Act decision engine
stage: AI risk detection and decision support
use_case: When a ground reply takes minutes, decides per incident whether to act now, act safely and consult, or wait. This is the central question of the project.
how_we_build_it: Take forecast time-to-critical from X02; compare with round-trip delay from F070; act now if the chance of harm before a reply exceeds a tuned threshold, else act safely and queue a consult (F069). Cost table documented. Reuses the F060 executor.
done_when: 1,000 simulated incidents at 0, 2, 10, 20 and 44 minute delay: policy compared with always-wait and always-act on time-to-treatment and missed deteriorations; reproducible with make eval.
proof_metric: Policy beats always-wait and always-act on missed deteriorations and time-to-treatment (simulation).
honest_limit: SELLING POINT. Depends on X02 and F070.

name: Per-astronaut Bayesian baseline (N-of-1)
stage: AI risk detection and decision support
use_case: Each astronaut gets a personal model of normal with a population prior, so alerts are probabilities about that person. Matches NASA's small-crew data problem.
how_we_build_it: Hierarchical or state-space model per metric with partial pooling and online updates; outputs posterior band, probability of deviation and a short forecast. F018 stays as the simple comparison baseline.
done_when: About 90 percent of values fall inside the 90 percent credible band on held-out windows; detection latency beats fixed thresholds in a leave-one-person-out test; works with a crew of 4.
proof_metric: Interval coverage, detection latency vs fixed thresholds, leave-one-person-out.
honest_limit: SELLING POINT. Backbone for X01, X03, X04, X08, X09.

name: Microgravity adaptation priors
stage: AI risk detection and decision support
use_case: Separates normal early-flight adaptation from illness so alerts do not fire on expected shifts.
how_we_build_it: Time-varying priors on X02 per mission mode, using only effects documented in NASA sources; adaptation curve shown in the UI with source links.
done_when: Every encoded effect has a citation; simulated adaptation does not trigger alerts while an injected illness does.
proof_metric: Adaptation does not alert; injected illness does.
honest_limit: SELLING POINT. Do not encode effects you cannot cite.

name: Conformal abstention ('AI unsure')
stage: AI risk detection and decision support
use_case: Gives calibrated prediction sets and says unsure, escalate when they are ambiguous.
how_we_build_it: Split-conformal wrapper on the F045 classifier and F043 score with rolling recalibration. Time series are not exchangeable, so the guarantee is approximate and stated that way. Builds on F048.
done_when: Risk-coverage curve committed; abstains on out-of-distribution test windows; coverage reported.
proof_metric: Risk-coverage curve and abstention rate on out-of-distribution windows.
honest_limit: SELLING POINT.

name: Real-signal bridge (camera pulse + optional sensor)
use_case: Puts a real live signal on screen so not everything is simulated.
how_we_build_it: Browser fingertip or face-camera pulse (PPG) gives HR and rough HRV, sent into F013. Optional MAX30102 plus ESP32 over Web Serial for HR and SpO2 (adapter per F008). Tagged REAL by F125. Not medical grade. Never claim SpO2 from the camera.
done_when: Live HR from a volunteer appears on the dashboard within 2 s tagged REAL; error versus a smartwatch or pulse oximeter reported over 5 minutes on 3 people.
proof_metric: Error versus a reference device over 5 minutes on 3 people.
honest_limit: SELLING POINT. Fixes the 'no sensors' credibility gap.

done_when: Network cable pulled: assistant keeps answering with citations; 50-question supported-answer rate and 50-prompt red-team result reported; RAM and latency recorded.
proof_metric: Supported-answer rate on 50 questions; red-team on 50 prompts; RAM and latency.
honest_limit: SELLING POINT. Builds on F055-F059.

name: Self-watchdog and safe fallback
stage: AI risk detection and decision support
